visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a close-up shot of fresh ingredients—zucchini, red and yellow bell peppers, and large king oyster mushrooms—arranged neatly on a tan cutting board next to a stainless steel tray containing raw chicken thighs. (2) A wide angle reveals a clean, minimalist home kitchen with a white countertop. Several finished dishes, including a pot of stew, rice, and a colorful roasted vegetable platter, are already laid out under bright, warm indoor lighting. (3) A woman with her hair tied back in a ponytail, wearing a white t-shirt and a light beige apron, stands at the sink. She is shown washing the peppers and zucchini thoroughly under a stream of water from the tap. (4) She prepares an air-fryer rack by lining it with a sheet of crumpled aluminum foil. She then uses a large chef's knife to slice the green bell peppers into long, uniform strips on her cutting board. (5) The editing features fast cuts of the woman chopping the various colorful vegetables. She demonstrates focused micro-actions, her hands moving efficiently to slice the red peppers, yellow peppers, mushrooms, and zucchini into small chunks. (6) The woman seasons the prepared vegetables directly on the tray using a tall spice grinder. She then pours a dark Japanese-style sauce over the raw chicken in a separate tray and sprinkles it with herb salt before mixing with her hands. (7) She carefully arranges the seasoned chicken thighs on top of the bed of mixed vegetables. This layering technique is designed to let the chicken fat flavor the vegetables during the roasting process in the oven. (8) A fresh salmon fillet is shown being patted dry with a paper towel. The woman then seasons the fish with freshly ground black pepper and pink salt, preparing it for its turn in the countertop convection oven. (9) She places the loaded tray into a black and silver countertop oven, which has digital displays. The camera zooms in to show the food roasting behind the glass door as the oven's internal light illuminates the process. (10) At the stove, the woman demonstrates a heat test on a large stainless steel frying pan. She flickers water droplets into the pan; they bead up and dance across the surface, indicating the pan is perfectly heated. (11) After adding oil, she cracks three eggs into the hot pan. She uses a grey spatula to scramble them quickly, moving the pan with her other hand to ensure even cooking without the eggs sticking to the surface. (12) She removes the eggs and sautés sliced onions in a clear garlic oil. She then adds the scrambled eggs back into the pan, seasoning the mixture with a dash of sauce before tossing it all together and plating. (13) In the final cooking step, she stir-fries a large bowl of shredded green cabbage in the same stainless steel pan, showing how the moisture from the vegetables helps deglaze the pan and keep it clean. (14) The cooked chicken is removed from the oven and cut into pieces using heavy-duty kitchen scissors. The final shot displays the full dinner spread: roasted chicken with vegetables, seasoned salmon, onion scrambled eggs, and stir-fried cabbage.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 我家晚餐. [Subtitle]: 從備料開始. (2) [Subtitle]: 我會一次把菜備好. (3) [Subtitle]: 洗洗切切最療癒了. (4) [Subtitle]: 這是香料烤雞的配菜. (5) [Subtitle]: 準備一些適合烤的蔬菜. (6) [Subtitle]: 青椒\甜椒\杏鮑菇. (7) [Subtitle]: 喜歡在孩子們回家前 安靜的備料. (8) [Subtitle]: 用蒜鹽調味. (9) [Subtitle]: 洗乾淨擦乾水分的無骨雞腿排. (10) [Subtitle]: 日式燒肉醬 香料鹽. (11) [Subtitle]: 再炒個高麗菜. (12) [Subtitle]: 要做洋蔥炒蛋的. (13) [Subtitle]: 鋪上烘焙紙 魚肉比較不會黏在烤網上. (14) [Subtitle]: 調味用黑胡椒 + 玫瑰鹽. (15) [Subtitle]: 剛剛的雞腿放配菜上一起烤. (16) [Subtitle]: 底下的配菜利用雞腿的油 增加香氣. (17) [Subtitle]: 備菜完成!. (18) [Subtitle]: 拍張封面照! (您略我的大痘痘). (19) [Subtitle]: 跟食材借油 接著熱鍋. (20) [Subtitle]: 不鏽鋼鍋要加熱到水珠可以 在鍋上快速滑動 結成大顆水珠 熱鍋在完成了. (21) [Subtitle]: 倒油... 離火 常溫蛋比較不會黏喔! 多練習就能掌握了. (22) [Subtitle]: 原本我也是有點排斥用 不鏽鋼鍋的. (23) [Subtitle]: 無塗層鍋中 不鏽鋼鍋算是好上手的了 耐用不用易壞. (24) [Subtitle]: 在YT影片中分享的 自製蒜油 事先做起來 炒菜方便又快速. (25) [Subtitle]: 這邊還有昨天做的滷肉. (26) [Subtitle]: 蔬菜水分多 可以把剛剛的焦底 炒起來 還是很乾淨 不難吧. (27) [Subtitle]: 香噴噴的烤雞也好囉 接著鮭魚進去! 連續幫忙做菜 沒問題的. (28) [Subtitle]: 這個一定被小孩秒殺 有手就會做的一道簡單料理. (29) [Subtitle]: 鮭魚也是沒有任何技巧 幾乎都是新手煮婦 可以簡單抄作業的一餐. (30) [Subtitle]: 快回家吃飯吧!.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, cheerful acoustic pop music begins playing at a moderate tempo, featuring a rhythmic guitar strumming and a light electronic beat. The background is nearly silent, with only the faint, clean ambiance of a quiet indoor kitchen environment. (2) The sound of a water tap being opened is clearly heard, followed by the steady rushing and splashing of water hitting vegetables and a metal sink. This liquid texture overlaps seamlessly with the persistent, energetic background music track. (3) A sharp, crinkling metallic sound occurs as a sheet of aluminum foil is pulled from its box and torn against the serrated edge. This is followed by the sound of the foil being smoothed out flat onto a metal rack. (4) Rhythmic, percussive thuds of a sharp knife striking a plastic cutting board are heard as various vegetables are chopped. Each impact is crisp and distinct, punctuating the background music with a steady, functional culinary beat. (5) A mechanical, ratcheting grinding sound is produced as a spice mill is twisted multiple times. These short, high-frequency bursts of friction indicate the seasoning process and are clearly audible over the music bed. (6) A loud, continuous white-noise-like sizzling sound erupts as ingredients are placed into a preheated pan. This is accompanied by the rhythmic clinking and scraping of a silicone spatula against a stainless steel surface. (7) A sharp, electronic "ding" or notification chime sounds, likely signaling the completion of a kitchen appliance's cycle. This short, high-pitched transient stands out clearly against the ongoing background music and kitchen sounds. (8) The metallic snapping sound of kitchen shears is heard repeatedly as they cut through the crispy skin and meat of a cooked chicken thigh. The sound is dry and percussive, occurring in rapid succession during the plating phase.

It emphasizes 'healing' through the process of washing and cutting vegetables while offering practical tips for using stainless steel pans and countertop ovens to achieve professional-looking results at home.
